choose.when:
select table_name tableCode, table_comment tableName from information_schema.tables where table_schema = (select database())
and table_name
NOT
REGEXP #{regex}
order by create_time desc
choose.otherwise:
SELECT t.table_name AS tableCode, tc.comments AS tableName FROM all_tables t JOIN all_tab_comments tc ON t.table_name = tc.table_name AND t.owner = tc.owner WHERE t.owner = 'MIP'
and t.table_name = #{regex}

choose.when: select column_name fieldCode, data_type dataType, column_comment fieldName from information_schema.columns where table_name = #{tableCode} and table_schema = (select database()) order by ordinal_position
choose.otherwise: SELECT c.column_name AS fieldCode, c.data_type AS dataType, cc.comments AS fieldName FROM all_tab_columns c LEFT JOIN all_col_comments cc ON c.table_name = cc.table_name AND c.column_name = cc.column_name AND c.owner = cc.owner WHERE c.table_name = #{tableCode} AND c.owner = 'MIP' ORDER BY c.column_name

mapper.select: SELECT table_name as tableCode, column_name as fieldCode, data_type as dataType, column_id as sort FROM all_tab_columns WHERE table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY column_id
